_purpose: What each main party promised for the 2023 Telangana Assembly election, as reported at release. Amounts are quoted as published.

promises.promise: Rs 2,500 a month to women; LPG cylinder for Rs 500; free travel in TSRTC buses
Rs 15,000 per acre a year to farmers and tenant farmers; Rs 12,000 a year to agricultural labourers; Rs 500 per quintal bonus on paddy above MSP
A house site and Rs 5 lakh for house construction for the homeless; 250 sq. yd plots for families of Telangana movement martyrs
200 units of free electricity for every household
Vidya Bharosa card worth Rs 5 lakh for higher education; a Telangana International School in every mandal
Rs 4,000 monthly pension for the elderly, widows and other eligible groups; Rs 10 lakh Rajiv Arogyasri health cover
